created_by.description: Display name of the creator of this annotation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the panel annotation.

labels.description:
Map of user-supplied key:value pairs associated with the annotation. The
following maximums apply:
- Number of labels per annotation: `50`
- Key character length: `200`
- Value character length: `500`

starts_at.description: The start of the time period being annotated.

target_reference.description: The `slug` of the resource being annotated.

title.description:
A short description explaining the annotation.
Max length, 100 characters.

type.description: The type of resource being annotated.
